thread:
deploybot: Canary deploy started for service `spark-bridge` in prod-us-east. Tag: v2.4.9-canary. Commit: f2d3a9b. Targeted traffic: 3% (3 pods). Change window: 30m. Runbook link: https://go/runbooks/spark-bridge. Notify @chris for rollout decisions.
chris: ack, I'm watching. Primary signals: 5xx rate, p95 latency, error budget burn.
alin: kicking off smoke tests now — simple health + sample inference. curl check: ```curl -sSf https://api.prod-us-east/spark-bridge/health || echo FAIL```
nicole: initial metrics: small bump in 5xx on canary -> 1.2% (baseline 0.1%). p95 +40ms. traffic volume tiny tho.
kira: running the automated canary-checker against last 10m. CPU on canary pods slightly higher, but within threshold. I'll keep the checker running.
chris: decision threshold: if 5xx > 2% sustained or p95 delta > 150ms => rollback. Otherwise hold for 15m then consider bump.
alin: spotted a config mismatch in the new image (worker_threads unset). Patching deployment now to set WORKER_THREADS=8 for canary. Applying via `kubectl -n prod patch deploy spark-bridge --patch "spec:..."`
deploybot: Patch applied to deployment/spark-bridge (canary replica set). Replicas still 3. Monitor window reset to 15m.
nicole: after config patch: 5xx back down to 0.4%, p95 delta now +12ms. Looks stable for the moment. Recommend bump to 10%.
chris: approved. bump to 10% and continue observing for 20m.
deploybot: Traffic split updated: canary -> 10% (3 -> 6 pods). Commit pinned: f2d3a9b (v2.4.9-canary). Smoke checks restarting.
kira: small CPU spike on one node while new pods warm up, auto-rebalanced. No errors.
alin: quick note: I pushed a tiny healthcheck tweak to the canary config (non-binary change) to reduce log noise.
nicole: after 20m at 10%: 5xx = 0.2%, p95 +9ms, error budget stable.
chris: good. Recommend ramp to 50% per runbook. Schedule final cut at 02:00 UTC if 50% stays green for 30m.
deploybot: Ramp executed. Traffic split: canary -> 50%. Tag locked to v2.4.9-canary (commit f2d3a9b). Release note draft: https://go/notes/desc-274.
alin: :thumbsup: I'll update changelog and add the small healthcheck note.
kira: still watching, no regressions in traces or SLOs.
chris: final hold window 30m complete and signals are clean. Proceed to full rollout at scheduled window. If any spike appears, rollback plan: `kubectl set image deploy/spark-bridge spark-bridge=registry/redwood/spark-bridge:v2.4.8` and notify infra-oncall.
deploybot: Canary finished and promoted to staged ramp. Final rollout scheduled at 02:00 UTC. Thread closed unless a rollback trigger appears.
